objective: Produce qualifying evidence of a real provider-connected LLM/agent application delivered through an executable, deployed path with verification and receipts.

retrieval_gate.rule: Do not build until existing-estate retrieval is exhausted or the operator explicitly chooses to build anyway.

minimum_system.provider: Claude/Anthropic or another target-relevant production LLM provider; exact provider must be recorded.
minimum_system.application: A user-facing or operator-facing application that performs a bounded real workflow, not merely model echo/chat.
minimum_system.deployment: A reachable deployed runtime or independently exercised hosted environment.

acceptance: At least one real provider request succeeds from the deployed application path.
At least one failure path is exercised and recorded.
Provider/model/runtime versions or identifiers are recorded.
Automated tests cover deterministic application logic around the model boundary.
An evaluation set measures task success or output quality with a declared rubric.
A deployment receipt binds source revision, runtime, verification result, and public artifact.
A public-safe case study describes problem, architecture, implementation, evaluation, deployment, limitations, and reproduction path.
claim_ceiling: This packet can establish production LLM application delivery. It does not establish customer deployment/adoption unless real external-user evidence separately satisfies that requirement.
